turns.question: How many site sessions were there per order placed between 20 September and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: Between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-02 there were 7 site sessions with a page view and 75 orders placed; the semantic layer has no sessions-per-order metric, so I did not compute that ratio.
